history.submitter_remarks: Gazette EN one word Clearwater; centreline CLEAR WATER BAY ROAD. Harmonizes former Sai Kung Road, Customs Pass Road and Clearwater Bay Road segments.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at junction of Prince Edward Road & Tam Kung Road, running north of Kai Tak Air Port, to Customs Pass and thence to Clearwater Bay (formerly known in parts as Sai Kung Road, Customs Pass Road & Clearwater Bay Road).

history.submitter_remarks: Gazette EN Kun Tong; centreline KWUN TONG ROAD.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at what was formerly known as the junction of Sai Kung Road & Customs Pass Road & running in a south-easterly direction towards Kun Tong (formerly known as part of Sai Kung Road).

history.submitter_remarks: Tai Po Tsai–Sai Kung Village segment. Earlier G.N.202 1922-05-05 (西貢路) on file; map year stays 1922.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at Clearwater Bay Road near Tai Po Tsai running in a northerly direction & terminating at Sai Kung Village.
